newsitem.title: GERMANY: German insolvencies rise to record in October.
newsitem.headline: German insolvencies rise to record in October.

text.p: Insolvencies rose to a record 2,879 cases in Germany in October, up 22.5 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Federal Statistics Office said on Friday.
Corporate insolvencies accounted for 2,327 cases, up 23.9 percent.
In the first 10 months of the year, insolvencies totaled 26,432 cases, up 11.9 percent from the year before. Corporate failures totaled 21,410, up 17.4 percent.
West Germany accounted for 2,100 of the October insolvencies, or which 1,640 were corporations. East Germany saw 779 insolvencies, of which 687 were corporations.
